title: Measles: the threshold and the coverage needed
caption: With R₀ = 15 the immune fraction must reach 1 − 1/15 ≈ 0.933. A vaccine that is 97% effective needs coverage 0.933/0.97 ≈ 0.962 to get there.
alt: A number line from 0.9 to 1 with two marked points: 0.933, the herd immunity threshold, and 0.962, the vaccine coverage needed.
description: R₀ = 15, so the herd immunity threshold is 1 − 1/15 ≈ 0.933.
A 97%-effective vaccine protects 0.97 of those covered.
Coverage 0.933/0.97 ≈ 0.962 is needed: higher than the threshold itself.
